purpose: Challenge the GALAH Mn-history association with conventional stellar-population, selection, orbital, vertical-structure, and asymmetric-drift explanations before any persistence interpretation.
immutability: No challenge threshold, bin, abundance set, slab, or success rule may change after the corresponding challenge outcome is inspected. New choices require a new protocol version.

test_A_component_dominance.threshold_provenance: Same pre-existing 0.80 component-dominance threshold used in the frozen DR20 conventional challenge; not chosen from the Mn result.
test_A_component_dominance.rule: A vT-dominated result cannot by itself support persistence; the non-azimuthal components must be evaluated independently.

test_B_rich_chemistry.quality: Require flag_al_fe == flag_si_fe == flag_ca_fe == flag_ti_fe == flag_ni_fe == 0 and finite values; do not relax if sample shrinks.
test_B_rich_chemistry.model: Add the five standardized abundances linearly to both Mn and velocity nuisance models; retain all v0.2 controls and voxel fixed effects.
test_B_rich_chemistry.permutation: Use the original v0.2 voxel + age/Fe/Mg coarse strata.

test_C_field_selection.model: Keep the v0.2 coefficient model unchanged.
test_C_field_selection.permutation: Permute Mn_history only within voxel + survey_name + field_id + 1-Gyr age + 0.20-dex Fe/H + 0.10-dex Mg/Fe strata.
test_C_field_selection.power_report: Report number of permutable strata and stars in permutable strata; if fewer than 50 percent of modeled stars are permutable, classify this stress test as underpowered rather than relaxing strata.

test_D_vertical_structure.rule: Run the unchanged v0.2 statistic independently in each slab. A slab is powered only if it retains at least 12 supported voxels; do not merge slabs post hoc.

test_E_orbital_population.model: Add all six standardized orbital quantities linearly to both Mn and velocity nuisance models. L_Z is deliberately excluded because it is algebraically too close to the azimuthal target and would trivially over-control vT.
test_E_orbital_population.interpretation: This is an intentionally conservative post-primary migration/orbit-family challenge. Loss of the Mn association supports ordinary chemo-dynamical population structure; survival is necessary but not sufficient for persistence.

test_F_asymmetric_drift.sample: 7.0 <= R_Rzphi < 9.0 kpc and abs(z_Rzphi) < 0.50 kpc under v0.2 quality cuts
test_F_asymmetric_drift.mn_cohorts: Mn_history < 0 versus Mn_history >= 0 from the frozen v0.2 nuisance model; no percentile optimization.
test_F_asymmetric_drift.circular_velocity_provenance: GALAH DR4 dynamics documentation value at the adopted solar radius.
test_F_asymmetric_drift.jeans_baseline: Vc^2 - mean(vT)^2 = sigma_T^2 - sigma_R^2 * [1 + d ln(nu sigma_R^2)/d ln R] with tilt term set to zero for the baseline.
test_F_asymmetric_drift.tracer_density: Pooled quality-sample number density in cylindrical radial bins divided by annular R factor; this is catalog tracer density, not stellar mass density.
test_F_asymmetric_drift.gradient: Within each z slab fit equal-bin-weight linear regression of ln(nu sigma_R^2) on ln R using the pooled Mn cohorts; apply the same gradient to both Mn cohorts.

bootstrap.unit: within radial-bin x z-slab x Mn cohort

test_F_asymmetric_drift.estimand: Equal-supported-bin mean of observed high-minus-low Mn delta vT minus conventionally predicted high-minus-low Mn delta vT_AD.
test_F_asymmetric_drift.sufficiency: Asymmetric drift is quantitatively sufficient if zero lies inside the two-sided 95% bootstrap interval for the observed-minus-predicted residual.
test_F_asymmetric_drift.guardrail: Even if asymmetric drift is insufficient, this test is not evidence for persistence; the rich-chemistry, selection, vertical, orbital, and independent-survey checks remain required.

requires: test_B radial component permutation p <= 0.01 with the same sign as the parent primary
test_C adequately powered and radial component permutation p <= 0.01 with the same sign
at least two powered test_D slabs have radial effects with the parent-primary sign, with at least one radial component permutation p <= 0.01
test_E radial component retains the parent-primary sign and component permutation p <= 0.01
survival_rule.vT_rule: Azimuthal survival is reported separately and cannot satisfy the survival rule by itself.
survival_rule.replication_requirement: Even if this GALAH challenge survives, APOGEE independent replication remains mandatory before the persistence-compatible chemical-history label can be used.
